headline: Fuel Prices Tonight, October 6: Gasoline Up, Diesel Down, Diesel Down 15,000 Dong From Peak, Latest iPhone Duo Prices in Vietnam
summary: Vietnam's ceiling price for E10 RON 95-III gasoline is 27,189 dong per liter, with 0.05S diesel around 29,717 dong per liter. Diesel is reported down 15,000 dong from its peak.
why: Domestic fuel prices in Vietnam are set through periodic administered ceilings, which feed transport costs and inflation in the economy.
